description: This file defines a report for Fixed Asset Register in ERPNext, including data retrieval, filtering, and chart preparation functions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and chart based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Constructs filtering conditions for Asset data based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves asset data from the database, processes depreciation and supplier info.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for chart visualization, aggregating asset values and depreciation over periods.

methods.name: get_finance_book_value_map
methods.description: Fetches depreciation amounts from the database for assets up to a specified date.

methods.name: get_purchase_receipt_supplier_map
methods.description: Retrieves mapping of purchase receipts to suppliers for fixed assets.

methods.name: get_purchase_invoice_supplier_map
methods.description: Retrieves mapping of purchase invoices to suppliers for fixed assets.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on grouping filters.
